attchmntText: Insolation Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Insolation Energy Limited filed the newspaper publication of un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The results were published in The Economic Times English and Business Remedies Hindi on 14th November 2026. Consolidated total income from operations was Rs. 836.69 crore for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. Consolidated net profit was Rs. 25.06 crore. Standalone total income from operations was Rs. 6.25 crore. Standalone net loss was Rs. 2.07 crore. The consolidated financial results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors on 13th November 2026. Earnings per share was Rs. 1.67.

attchmntText: Insolation Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Press Release on Financial Results".
voiceSummary: Insolation Energy Limited filed a press release on November 13, 2026, regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations for Q2FY27 stood at Rs. 836.69 Crores, representing a 96.45% year-on-year increase. For H1FY27, revenue doubled to Rs. 1,582.09 Crores, up 100.56% year-on-year. EBITDA for H1FY27 was Rs. 140.31 Crores, up 23.30% year-on-year. Net profit for H1FY27 was Rs. 63.08 Crores. The company reported an order book of approximately 2.2 GW, with 1.3 GW scheduled for delivery by March 2027. A 4.5 GW TOPCon cell facility is nearing commissioning. RIPS-2022 incentives of up to Rs. 224 Crores have been secured.

attchmntText: Intimation under Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations andDisclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015: Transfer of equity shares held by Insolation Green Energy Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Insolation Energy Limited, in its Wholly Owned Subsidiary Companies
voiceSummary: Insolation Energy Limited intimates that its wholly owned subsidiary, Insolation Green Energy Private Limited, proposes to transfer 49% stakes in two subsidiaries. The stake in HPJG Green Infra Private Limited will be transferred to Mr. Manish Gupta and Mrs. Payal Gupta. The stake in DGEJ Green Infra Private Limited will be transferred to Mr. Vikas Jain and Mrs. Ekta Jain. Both sets of buyers belong to the promoter group. The transactions are classified as related party transactions executed on an arm's length basis. The total consideration for the entire 100% equity shareholding in each entity is Rs. 1,00,000. The agreement for sale was entered into on 13th November, 2026. The remaining 51% stakes will be transferred later per transaction terms. Upon these transfers, the entities will cease to be wholly owned subsidiaries but remain subsidiaries. The transactions are outside the Scheme of Arrangement. Completion is subject to requisite approvals.

attchmntText: Insolation Energy Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Insolation Energy Limited announced the Board of Directors meeting held on 13th November 2026. The Board approved the Un-Audited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The results include Standalone and Consolidated figures. The Limited Review Report is enclosed. The meeting started at 03:14 P.M. and ended at 03:31 P.M. The statutory auditors issued an unmodified opinion on the financial results. The company manufactures solar panels and sells electricity. During the quarter, the company allotted equity shares under its Employee Stock Option Plan. The shares were allotted at an exercise price of Rs. 3.80 each. The financial statements are prepared in accordance with Indian Accounting Standards.
